During a full international cutoff, no software can help. These are the real, practical paths:
The state\'s paid international access (50GB operator packages). If you are legally eligible, Gh Protocol works on top of it — just import the config.
At the borders: a foreign SIM gives direct global access. Legal and the most reliable path in a full cutoff.
The only hardware path during a full cutoff — with serious legal risks in Iran (up to 5 years for distribution) and GPS jamming. Informational only.
Defyx, Mahsa NG, Simorgh — try them in parallel if this app cannot connect (open source).
